class.description: Drives a VDA 5050 route through rover_mission_manager (set_mission / run_mission).
Position, velocity, battery, operating mode, pause, safety and errors of the rover.
VDA 5050 startPause: stop driving and keep the order.
VDA 5050 stopPause: continue the order from the first node not yet reached.
enableAuxOutput: switch aux outputs 1..6 (safety PLC DIO00..05) on.
disableAuxOutput: switch aux outputs 1..6 (safety PLC DIO00..05) off.
